syntax: English tag name in angle brackets, placed inline exactly where the sound happens, e.g. 'Around 09:15 <short pause> Admiral Kurita ordered a recall.' Keep tags in English for non-English scripts.

sources.ui: AI Studio gemini-3.8-flash-tts '+ Expression' chip row, zero-send probe 3, 2026-10-09 (.runtime/claude_full_completion_20261009/attempt_22_flash_adapter/probe3_receipt.json)
sources.docs: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/speech-generation 'Recommended vocal tags' (fetched 2026-10-09); the 40 UI chips and the documented list are identical
sources.guidance: Use angle brackets; human vocalizations only, no sound effects; put delivery (tone, mood, pace) in the Style box, which applies to the whole speech block

levels.recommended: safe for any narrator; use sparingly
levels.casual: light, friendly or humorous narration only
levels.dramatic: strong emotional moments; at most one or two per script
levels.avoid: not for narrators; rejected unless the direction file lists the tag in allow_tags

style_presets.Friendly: Warm and neutral delivery with micro-pauses
style_presets.Narration: commanding, rich vocal modulation, dramatic pauses
